summary: Velocity Financial's subsidiary Velocity Commercial Capital entered an Equity Purchase Agreement to acquire all equity interests of three entities (formed via statutory division) from Toorak Capital LLC. Consideration is approximately $62 million plus estimated tangible book value, subject to adjustments. Closing conditions include regulatory approvals, completion of a related 'Back Book Acquisition,' warehouse financing conditions, and no material adverse effect. The deal must close within 120 days or termination rights apply. Watch for regulatory approvals and the Back Book Acquisition completion as key conditions to closing.
